# Changelog

## 1.0.0 - 2026-08-01

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation of the central dense and sparse computational layer of Matrix 1.7-6.
- Added native CSR and CSC sparse matrix types.
- Added dense and sparse construction, arithmetic, decompositions, solves, matrix functions, orderings, and Matrix Market I/O.
- Added checked and optimized regression suites, examples, and an upstream source snapshot.
